question: When a cement producer and customer report conflicting 28-day mortar strength results for the same dispatch lot, how should an independent research agent distinguish sampling representativeness, curing and test-method differences, and chain-of-custody errors before assigning product nonconformity?
category: Cement strength dispute and split-sample traceability
scenario: Supplier and buyer laboratories report materially different 28-day compressive strength on purportedly identical cement dispatch lot
evidence_required: Dispatch batch and silo identification, sampling point/time, composite-versus-grab procedure, sample sealing and custody transfer log
Applicable declared cement standard and method edition, specimen preparation, water/cement and sand details, curing temperature/humidity and testing machine calibration
Replicate specimen strengths, ages, outlier handling, laboratory accreditation scope, retained split samples and independent referee laboratory protocol
answer_and_decision_guide: First establish whether both laboratories actually tested representative material from the same identified lot. Compare sample preparation, storage, test age and the exact applicable standard before comparing strength values. Check equipment traceability, replicate dispersion and documented deviations; commission an agreed independent split-sample/referee test where contracts and sample condition permit. Keep contractual acceptance limits separate from statistical test uncertainty. Do not assert defective cement, change formulation or settle a claim from two unverified summary numbers.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained directory for navigation only; obtain the applicable official EN/ASTM or national test standard, contractual specification and accredited laboratory records; no claim that this page is an authoritative test method.
free_first_decision: Use existing test certificates, plant QC logs, buyer lab reports and accessible standard summaries first. Paid library material is unnecessary unless an exact relevant document and edition is missing and its permitted use is confirmed.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Verify exact filename, edition, rights, price and written buyer approval before recommending any paid digital package; never purchase automatically.

model_limitations: No underlying samples, contract acceptance clause, laboratory raw data, applicable standard edition or independent test result supplied; cannot decide conformance or liability.
